sources.title: Graph Engineering: The Karpathy Loop, Improved 1000x by Itself / The Anthropic Playbook
sources.note: Primary conceptual anchor for this report. Its source note disclaims affiliation and endorsement. Historical counts, promotional multipliers, timing estimates, and vendor limits are not treated as measured project outcomes.

sources.title: Karpathy: autoresearch
sources.note: Supports the bounded experiment surface, protected evaluation utilities, short evaluation loop, and retained/discarded candidate history. Does not establish general software-delivery productivity.

sources.title: Anthropic: Building effective agents
sources.note: Supports choosing simple composable workflows and distinguishing workflows from agents. Used here for architecture selection, not universal performance claims.

sources.title: Anthropic: Effective harnesses for long-running agents
sources.note: Describes initialization, incremental coding, durable handoff artifacts, and application-level testing across context windows. Evidence is specific to the described experiments.

sources.title: OpenAI: Harness engineering
sources.note: Supports repository-accessible knowledge and mechanically enforced architecture. This is an engineering account, not a controlled benchmark of this report's proposed method.

sources.title: Anthropic: Knowledge graph construction with Claude
sources.note: Demonstrates extraction, resolution, graph assembly, and subgraph querying with provenance. Structured output and graph connectivity are not truth guarantees.

sources.title: Anthropic: Effective context engineering for AI agents
sources.note: Supports selective context, external notes, and focused subagent contexts. This report adds its own retrieval contracts and omission-handling rules.

sources.title: Anthropic: Harness design for long-running application development
sources.note: Provides a counterweight to overengineering: some scaffolding became unnecessary with stronger models; evaluator value depended on the task. Reported demos are not matched-scope causal productivity estimates.

sources.title: Claude Code: Dynamic workflows
sources.note: Supports script-held coordination, advisory size guidelines, resumption behavior, and approval-stage limits. Availability, quotas, APIs, and exact limits require rechecking at implementation.

sources.title: LangGraph: Persistence
sources.note: Distinguishes thread checkpointers from cross-thread stores. In-memory checkpoints do not survive process restart.

sources.title: LangGraph: Interrupts
sources.note: Documents approval pauses and that a resumed node restarts from its beginning. Used to illustrate why external effects need replay-safe design.

sources.title: Beads: agent-oriented graph issue tracking
sources.metadata: Current repository resolves to gastownhall/beads; checked 16 September 2026.
sources.note: Documents dependency-aware tasks, claimable work, structured output, and Dolt-backed persistence. Not an endorsement or a substitute for acceptance qualification.
